theorems.statement: ∀ {n ℓ : ℕ} (M : Set (Amb n ℓ)), 1 ≤ n → Poincare.SimonGMT.Chapter03.CountablyRectifiable n M → ∃ (N₀ : Set (Amb n ℓ)) (G : ℕ → Rn n → Amb n ℓ) (c : ℕ → Rn n) (ρ : ℕ → ℝ), (μHE[n] : Measure (Amb n ℓ)) N₀ = 0 ∧ (∀ k, ContDiff ℝ 1 (G k)) ∧ (∀ k, ∀ v ∈ ball (c k) (ρ k), Function.Injective (fderiv ℝ (G k) v)) ∧ (∀ k, ∃ κ : ℝ, 0 < κ ∧ ∀ v ∈ ball (c k) (ρ k), ∀ w ∈ ball (c k) (ρ k), κ * ‖v - w‖ ≤ ‖G k v - G k w‖) ∧ M ⊆ N₀ ∪ ⋃ k, G k '' ball (c k) (ρ k)
